payload.claim: The 'Why 120 seconds' note's claim that 'Keepalive gives up on a dead link after 60 seconds' is a loose paraphrase of ServerAliveInterval=15 / ServerAliveCountMax=4 (the actual worst case before ssh gives up can run a bit past 60s depending on when the first missed probe is counted from). The only load-bearing fact, PUSH_TIMEOUT_S (120) > 15*4 (60), holds regardless, so this costs nothing to leave as is.
